summary: All 5 TDD-anchor scenarios plus 5 bonus scenarios (10 tests total in TestReviewListener) pass, and the full suite (65/65 in test_integration.py, 1324/1324 project-wide) is green. Tests are genuinely synchronous/deterministic: Bot is mocked in every case, the outer loop is driven in-thread via a threading.Event stop-seam (no real threading.Thread spawned except in the gate test, where threading.Thread itself is mocked), backoff constants are patched to 0, and the whole class runs in ~1-2s with zero real sleeps/sockets. Mutation testing confirms 3 of the 4 requested litmus scenarios are caught (admin gate bypass, offset never advancing, edit-on-ignored-press); the 4th (409/error hot-loop) is NOT caught — removing the backoff/sleep call entirely from either the Conflict branch or the generic-Exception branch leaves every test green, because both 'backoff' tests assert only on log-message text, never on the backoff call itself. This is a real, non-blocking gap against an explicit task requirement ('не busy-loop-ить на повторяющейся ошибке').

findings.issue: Neither test asserts that a backoff/sleep actually happens on a repeating getUpdates failure — they only assertLogs(...ERROR...) and check substrings in the log line ('409'+'one' / 'review listener'). Verified by mutation: deleting the '_review_listener_sleep(stop_event, REVIEW_LISTENER_CONFLICT_BACKOFF_SECONDS)' call in the Conflict except-branch, and separately deleting '_review_listener_sleep(stop_event, REVIEW_LISTENER_ERROR_BACKOFF_SECONDS)' in the generic Exception except-branch, each leaves the corresponding test (and the full ReviewListener class) 100% green. A regression that turns a repeating-error path into a hot busy-loop would ship undetected. The production code today DOES call the backoff correctly (confirmed by reading news_bot.py:849-875) — this is a test-assertion gap, not a current behavior bug.
findings.recommendation: In both tests, patch 'news_bot._review_listener_sleep' (or 'news_bot.time.sleep' / assert on stop_event.wait call count) as a spy and assert it was invoked with the expected backoff constant (REVIEW_LISTENER_CONFLICT_BACKOFF_SECONDS / REVIEW_LISTENER_ERROR_BACKOFF_SECONDS) once per triggered failure, in addition to the existing log assertions. Re-run the same two mutations after the fix to confirm they now fail.

admin_gate_bypass_in_handler.method: Mutated _handle_review_update to hardcode from_user_id=424242 instead of reading callback_query.from_user.id. test_ignored_press_answers_empty_and_never_edits and test_callback_letter_maps_to_full_word both failed (edit_message_text awaited when it should not have been).

offset_never_advancing.method: Mutated _run_review_listener to drop 'offset = update.update_id + 1'. test_review_listener_handler_error_advances_offset_and_survives failed: seen_offsets == [None, None] instead of [None, 8].

edit_called_on_ignored_press.method: Mutated _handle_review_update to skip the 'status_text is None' early-return (ignored-press guard). test_ignored_press_answers_empty_and_never_edits failed (raised TypeError concatenating None, then would have failed assert_not_awaited regardless).

409_hot_loop.method: Mutated both the Conflict-branch and generic-Exception-branch backoff calls away (replaced with a bare 'continue'). test_review_listener_conflict_409_logged_with_backoff and test_review_listener_error_does_not_propagate both still passed — neither asserts the sleep/backoff call happened, only that an ERROR was logged.

tddAnchorCoverage.test_review_listener_dispatches_admin_ca: present, passes; verifies edit_message_text called with reply_markup=None and appended status text, answer_callback_query with correct text, INFO log with action+link+status, and real DB state (pending row gone, not published) via a spy-wrapped real resolve_dedup_callback

determinism.notes: No real threading.Thread is started in any test except test_review_listener_starts_when_enabled_and_numeric_admin, where threading.Thread itself is patched to a MagicMock. _run_review_listener is invoked directly (synchronously, in the test's own thread) with a threading.Event stop-seam that fake_get_updates closures set after 1-2 iterations. Bot is always patched to a MagicMock/AsyncMock — zero real network I/O. Backoff constants (REVIEW_LISTENER_ERROR_BACKOFF_SECONDS / REVIEW_LISTENER_CONFLICT_BACKOFF_SECONDS) are patched to 0, and _review_listener_sleep delegates to stop_event.wait(seconds) which returns immediately for seconds=0 and a set/settable event. Full TestReviewListener class runs in ~1-2s wall clock (measured), confirming no real sleeps.
